description: Sets your speech bubble, which people near you see for 20 seconds, and says whether a guide heard it. An empty text clears it. At most 72 characters shown: a link, <link href="https://...">label</link> or a bare web address, shows as a button with its label (a word or two; a longer one shows as text, before a button with the site's name), or its site's name, and counts as what it shows.
name: say
title: Say
